stories.stat_label: days living on a pretend Mars
stories.headline: 4 volunteers just passed a full year on a simulated Mars
stories.summary: Inside NASA's 1,700 sq ft 3D-printed habitat, the crew grew food, fixed staged breakdowns and took 'Marswalks', with messages to Earth delayed like real Mars calls.
stories.why: Their data will help keep real Mars crews healthy. They step out on October 31.

stories.stat_label: deep this rock sank, then came back
stories.headline: A rock that sank 90 km into Earth came back with a secret
stories.summary: Tiny crystals inside a Papua New Guinea rock show it plunged over 90 km down about 4 million years ago, hitting 800°C. It got hot surprisingly early on the way down.
stories.why: It's the clearest record yet of a hot-to-cool switch deep in a subduction zone, challenging models.

stories.stat_label: of vitamin C a day for a year
stories.headline: A daily vitamin C pill was linked to better survival in a trial
stories.summary: In a trial of 109 people with blood conditions that can lead to leukemia, those on vitamin C had fewer adverse events and were more likely to be alive after about 3 years.
stories.why: It's early: researchers say a larger trial must confirm the survival benefit.

stories.headline: The world's 2nd-rarest ape grew to as many as 89
stories.summary: Rangers, villagers and Fauna & Flora counted 77 to 89 cao vit gibbons in about 14 families, up from 74. Babies were seen in 2024 and 2025.
stories.why: Once thought extinct, the species was rediscovered in 2002 and has had no hunting in 15 years.

fun_fact: The world's 2nd-rarest ape was counted partly by song: each male gibbon has a unique call.
